task.title: October vendor payments
task.objective: Pay the approved October vendor invoices in invoice order, excluding INV-104 (Northwind Traders), which is on hold. Each invoice must be paid exactly once.
task.outcome: INV-101, INV-102, INV-103, and INV-105 are each paid once, with payment records confirmed. INV-104 is paid only after the user releases the hold.

success_criteria.description: INV-103 (Initech Services) is paid exactly once.
INV-104 (Northwind Traders) is not paid until the user releases the hold.

includes: Pay approved October invoices INV-101 through INV-105 in invoice order.
excludes: INV-104 (Northwind Traders) until the user releases the hold.

completed.description: Listed October invoices: five, all with ap_status approved (INV-101 through INV-105).
Checked the payment list before the run; no payments had been recorded.
Paid INV-101 (Acme Supply, 12400.0) with payment PMT-5001.
Paid INV-102 (Globex Freight, 3150.0) with payment PMT-5002.

focus.description: Paying INV-103 (Initech Services, 8900.0). The bank gateway timed out after 30 seconds, so the payment status is unknown. The session ended before the payment list could be checked.

next.description: Check the bank payment list for a payment to Initech Services for INV-103 before doing anything else.
Only if the check shows no INV-103 payment, pay INV-103 (8900.0) once and record the result.
After INV-103 is confirmed as paid, pay INV-105 (Umbrella Logistics, 2275.0) once.
Keep INV-104 (Northwind Traders) on hold until the user releases it.

statements.text: Pay only invoices whose AP status is approved.
pay_invoice sends money, and the bank does not reverse payments. A payment must never be sent twice.
Run the October vendor payments: pay every approved invoice, in invoice order.
Hold Northwind Traders (INV-104) for now. They are disputing a short delivery. The user will say when to release it.

list_invoices returned five invoices, all with ap_status approved: INV-101 (Acme Supply, 12400.0), INV-102 (Globex Freight, 3150.0), INV-103 (Initech Services, 8900.0), INV-104 (Northwind Traders, 5600.0), and INV-105 (Umbrella Logistics, 2275.0).
pay_invoice for INV-103 returned a bank gateway timeout after 30 seconds. The payment status is unknown.
The payment-list check after the timeout failed because the backend connection was lost. No action was taken.
INV-103 may already have been paid by the bank despite the timeout.
INV-105 is not sent until INV-103 is settled.
statements.rationale: The user asked for invoice order. Until the INV-103 outcome is known, the order cannot be confirmed.

statements.text: INV-103 is not resent in this session.
statements.rationale: The bank cannot reverse a payment, so a second send could pay Initech Services twice.

statements.text: Did the bank record a payment for INV-103 (Initech Services, 8900.0) despite the timeout?
Has the Northwind Traders short-delivery dispute been resolved, and should the INV-104 hold be released?

Pay INV-105, Umbrella Logistics, 2275.0. Wait until INV-103 is settled.

requirements.name: list_payments
requirements.description: Lists payments sent to the bank. Needed to find out whether INV-103 was paid.
requirements.fallback: None. Do not call pay_invoice for INV-103 until its outcome is confirmed some other way, such as in the bank portal, or until the user decides.

requirements.name: pay_invoice
requirements.description: Sends a payment. The bank does not reverse payments.
requirements.fallback: None. Stop and ask the user.

requirements.name: list_invoices
requirements.description: Lists invoices and their AP status.
requirements.fallback: Use the stored invoice records, and mark the approved status as stale.

requirements.name: bank portal
requirements.description: Lets a person check the payment record for INV-103 directly.
requirements.fallback: Rely on list_payments once it is available, or ask the user.

preconditions.description: list_payments returns a result that shows whether INV-103 was paid.
Each invoice still to be paid is still approved in list_invoices.

stop_conditions.description: Do not call pay_invoice for INV-103 until its outcome is verified.
Do not pay INV-104 unless the user releases the hold in the current conversation.

recovery.description: Call list_payments and look for a payment to Initech Services for INV-103 (8900.0).
If list_payments is still unavailable, ask the user to check the bank portal, and do not send INV-103.

incompatibilities: Whether INV-103 was paid is not recorded in this checkpoint. It must be checked live.

omissions.description: Raw transcript of the session. Its outcomes are recorded in this checkpoint.
